record.question: The famous teen climate activist, Greta Thunberg belongs to which country?
record.explanation: Answer B: Sweden. Greta Thunberg is Swedish; her official biography and Swedish government sources identify her as a Swedish climate activist. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/biography/Greta-Thunberg; https://www.government.se/government-policy/the-global-goals-and-the-2030-agenda-for-sustainable-development/greta-thunberg/.
